title: My School Subjects
text:
My favorite school subject is science. We learn about plants and animals. Our teacher shows us pictures and we do small experiments.

Maria likes math. She counts numbers every day. Her brother likes art because he can draw colorful pictures.

questions.text: What is the writer's favorite school subject?
Why does the writer like science?
options: Because it is interesting to do experiments
Because it is easy to sleep in class
Because the teacher is always angry
Because it is only on Sundays

questions.text: What can we guess about Maria's brother?
options: He does not go to school

vocabulary.definition: tests done to learn something new
living things that grow in soil and need water and light

paragraph_translations: Benim en sevdiğim okul dersi fen bilimleridir. Bitkiler ve hayvanlar hakkında öğreniriz. Öğretmenimiz bize resimler gösterir ve biz küçük deneyler yaparız.
Maria matematiği sever. Her gün sayılar sayar. Kardeşi resim dersini sever çünkü renkli resimler çizebilir.
